about: Black Hole Fishing fish traits, read from the player's BHF install. Ids, names and effects must come from the game's own data - fill after reading it.

columns.id: trait id as it appears in BHF's data
columns.name: BHF display name
columns.bhf_resource: res:// path or data field in BHF's .pck that defines it
columns.bhf_effect: what the trait does in BHF
columns.battle_effect: how it changes the Deltarune battle (bullet pattern modifier)
columns.best_act: ACT id that spares best (acts sheet)
